cost.worker_wall_aggregation: Union of all recorded time intervals; nested/overlapping complete/run_exit spans count once, disjoint spans add.
cost.attempts_accounting_note: All recorded attempt events retained; successful forward sum excludes failed/unfinished attempts and loading/waiting. Missing cost is unknown, never zero.
cost.deployment_note: Simultaneous logit capture during original generation could avoid a second prefill; not implemented or benchmarked here. This144 scoring pass has real loading/prefill/forward cost.

score_definition: logit(S) - logit(Not); first label branch, not a calibrated three-class probability
stop_reason: Prescribed scoring target incomplete/invalid; no performance on the scored subset.
